independent_reconstruction.protocol: Blind reconstruction was written and hashed before author evidence or verifier source was opened.

statement_match_details.decisive_lemma: The all-N fractional-cover statement, Finset variant, vertex range {2,...,N}, exact total, and Stirling asymptotic all match the proof.
statement_match_details.exceptional_elements: 1 is excluded by {1} versus the empty Finset; 0 is incompatible with any other admitted element and hence with positive density.
statement_match_details.finite_boundary: The local Lean source uses Set.Icc 1 (N+1), whereas the prose and closure contract use [N]; this off-by-one is asymptotically harmless and does not enter the standalone lemma.
statement_match_details.scope: The decisive lemma closes only fractional feasibility. It does not prove an integral o(N) deletion or an infinite natural-density construction.

proved: Disjointization preserves the equal product and cardinality imbalance while counting each support element once.
w_N(n)=log(N/n)/log N covers every unequal-cardinality equal-product support for every N>=2.
The total weight is exactly (N log N-log(N!))/log N-1 and is asymptotic to N/log N.
The strict high tail eliminates all relations whose larger shore has size at most L, with o(N) deletion for L=o(log N).
The K_(s+1,s) edge-prime construction is distinct, squarefree, and support-minimal for all s>=2 via the signed coefficient equations c_x+c_y=0.
At each fixed N, admissibility is exactly hypergraph independence and the binary transversal ILP is complete.
open: An integral transversal of size o(N), equivalently a structured rounding loss o(log N) or another integral mechanism.
A coherent infinite set having a genuine natural density greater than 1-epsilon and controlling cross-scale relations.
author_exposition_repairs: The universal K_(s+1,s) minimality proof must use arbitrary signed coefficients, not only original-left versus original-right subproducts.
The finite verifier replays one maximizing witness at each cutoff, not every maximizing set.

novelty_check_details: No public exact-solution search was performed under the campaign restriction. A targeted local repository search found no earlier duplicate outside this campaign, but that is not a primary-literature priority check.

machine_reproduced.author_verifier_scope: PASS through N=18 and K-circuits through s=6; finite replay only.
machine_reproduced.independent_finite_check: A separately written direct subset-product versus hypergraph-independence comparison passed for every 2<=N<=12.

promotion_scope.promote: The explicit all-circuit fractional transversal with cost (1+o(1))N/log N, plus its exact bounded-length and long-minimal-circuit supporting results.
